rows.coder_note: Step 4: FinnGen named with reference 16 (Kurki 2023, DOI 10.1038/s41586-022-05473-8), which is the source of every FinnGen row R3 to R12; no release number is given and the sentence holds no attribute separating them (rule E not met); 8288 cases and 68,969 controls are counts with a name alone (rule I1).

Step 4 (rules D, I1): the biobank name with a general cohort citation (reference 17, Bycroft 2018, no dictionary row's source) and case/control counts; the data are taken from an existing GWAS dataset, not the authors' own analysis, so rule C does not apply; no release, accession or year. The counts sum to 361,194, but N alone without platform, panel or year does not identify a release.

Step 4 (rules C3, E/C5 not met): reference 15 (Sun 2023, DOI 10.1038/s41586-023-06592-6) is the source of four UKB-PPP rows and no sentence gives an attribute separating them; the Synapse deposit syn51364943 covers several rows and picks none; 54,219 participants equals no row's sample size; 'discovery and replication' describes the MR design, not the pQTL cohort.
